messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT - sudden surge in 429/503 rates for embeddings-prod (us-west-2). 429 spike started at ~2026-03-15T09:12Z, alert threshold exceeded. paging on-call.

Ben R.: I'm oncall, got the page. what's the scope?

Maria G.: Looking at the dashboards: embeddings-prod overall 429 rate ~3.8% (baseline 0.3), 503s up to 0.9%. Top contributors are heavy tenants: hatch-inc (~45% of 429s), appflow (~18%). Queue length on embedding workers is climbing, CPU on gpu-pool-emb-02 is pegged.

Samir P.: Thanks. Can someone check if recent deploy touched batching changes? Deploy bot shows no recent embedding runtime deploys in last 2 hours.

Carla S.: I see increased cold-KV fetch latency; also a couple of preempt events on node gpu-07.

Alice C.: Immediate mitigations: 1) tenant-level soft rate caps for hatch-inc and appflow 2) temporarily disable embeddings-batch endpoint 3) reduce global burst window. I'll patch rate table if Ben gives go.

Ben R.: Do it. Apply a 50% qps reduction for hatch-inc and 30% for appflow. Also disable /v1/embeddings/batch for 15m. Post commands please.

Alice C.: Running:
```
# reduce tenant qps
rwctl tenant update --tenant hatch-inc --embeddings-qps 12
rwctl tenant update --tenant appflow --embeddings-qps 28
# disable batch endpoint
infra toggle-endpoint --service embeddings --endpoint /v1/embeddings/batch --state off --expires 15m
```

Maria G.: Dashboard link: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/embeddings-prod?view=429-503

Carla S.: Also applying a short-term eviction policy on KV cache to free memory: evict-policy set=aggressive (10m)

Ben R.: Confirmed changes applied. Observability: enabling increased sampling and trace capture for embedding requests for next 20m.

(5m later)

Maria G.: Update: 429 rate dropped to 1.1% overall, hatch-inc 429s down 65% from peak. 503s unchanged ~0.8% — looks like queue drain in progress. Latency P95 for embeddings still a bit high ~850ms.

Samir P.: Good. Can we add a temporary route fallback to smaller embedding model for hatch-inc to reduce worker pressure?

Alice C.: Yes. I'll create a route rule that routes hatch-inc to embeddings-compact-v1 for new requests for 20m.

Alice C.: Command:
```
routes add --tenant hatch-inc --from embeddings-prod --to embeddings-compact-v1 --duration 20m
```

Carla S.: Applied. Also re-enabled batch endpoint in read-only mode for low-priority tenants only.

(15m after initial)

Maria G.: Metrics: overall 429 now 0.25%, 503 at 0.35% — stable. CPU on gpu-pool-emb-02 back to normal. Request backlog cleared.

Ben R.: Nice work. Notes for follow-up: 1) add per-tenant 429 alerts at 0.5% 2) investigate preemptions on gpu-07 3) consider autoscale buffer for embedding pool 4) revisit batch endpoint throttling behavior.

Priya N.: I'm taking handoff. Thanks team. I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and open a postmortem doc.

Ben R.: Thanks all. Closing the live mitigation. If anyone saw customer complaints, escalate to support with the standard message: "We're investigating transient rate limiting affecting embeddings, actions taken to reduce impact."

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved: mitigation in place and system metrics trending towards baseline. Incident auto-close scheduled in 60m.
